test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He won’t come to school tomorrow, won’t he?
solution:
The correct answer is **'won't he'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the form of **' a Tag question'.**
 
• Generally in **tag question sentences:**
 
 
• ***When the statement is negative (first part), the tag question should be positive (the second part).***
 
 
 
• **For example:**
 
 
• They will not help, **will they?**
 
• He does not drive so fast, **does he?**
 
 
 
• After observing the above-mentioned examples, **the sentence should be** - *He won't come to school tomorrow, **will he?***
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the concept with some more examples:

 
• ***When the statement is positive, the tag should be negative.***

 
 
• She has not finished her homework, **has she?**
 
• You do not cook food, **do you?**
